messages:
emily_sales: Heads-up — NTT Data POC is asking for a signed order form + DPA tomorrow. They attached their PO template and want a KMS attestation. Can legal/procurement advise on the quickest path?

raj_legal: I can take a quick look. Do we already have a redline against our standard DPA for NTT? If not, ask them to highlight which clauses they changed.

emily_sales: They swapped our subprocessor list and added a 45-day data deletion SLA. Attachment: NTT_PO_2026.pdf. They also want the orderform to include PO number field and billing contact.

taylor_procure: For PO number we can populate if finance issues one — which usually needs final orderform + signed MSA. Can we get them to accept a conditional PO in the meantime? 

emily_sales: I asked if a provisional PO (PO pending final invoice) works. NTT replied they need a PO on the signed orderform for internal routing.

raj_legal: 45-day deletion is aggressive. We can propose 'reasonable efforts' but can we offer a compromise: 90 days with KMS/HSM attestation and documented data access controls?

anna_sre: On KMS attestation — we can provide a statement of our KMS integration (Cloud KMS + HSM backing) and ops runbook excerpt, but we don't do customer-specific HSMs in hosted mode. We can offer Private deployment as option.

emily_sales: NTT prefers hosted API if possible. They asked for a signed statement that keys are tenant-isolated.

raj_legal: Draft response suggestion: short redline accepting 90-day deletion, provide KMS attestation language that is factual (no warranty). I'll paste proposed clause.

raj_legal: ```
KMS / Key Management Attestation: Redwood Inference confirms that within its hosted service, customer data encryption keys are logically isolated per customer and managed using industry-standard KMS controls. Redwood does not retain keys in plaintext and uses secure key management practices. This attestation is informational and does not expand contractual liability beyond the MSA.
```

emily_sales: Thanks — send me the redline and I'll push it to NTT. Can procurement confirm billing contact field + PO insertion?

_taylor_procure: finance confirmed: we can accept their PO field but need invoice-to and remit-to on the orderform. If NTT signs with a PO number, attach internal routing code. Finance prefers net30 unless otherwise negotiated.

emily_sales: NTT asked if net30 is fine — they prefer net45. Is that something we can agree to?

_taylor_procure: net45 is allowable for enterprise deals > $100k with finance approval. Is this POC expected to convert to paid?

emily_sales: POC target ARR is ~$150k if successful. I'll mark for finance approval.

raj_legal: Quick question — do we need their SOC or security questionnaire answers before signing? If it's a low-risk POC with no PHI, we can proceed with a conditional clause: security questionnaire in parallel, signature subject to satisfactory SOC/attestation within 30 days.

anna_sre: We have the standard security pack; for NTT we can offer our SOC2 report redaction. If they need a full questionnaire we can ask them to send it; responses usually take 3-5 business days.

emily_sales: I'm pushing for signature today. Proposed final checklist to move forward: 1) Legal sends redline DPA with KMS clause (raj) 2) Procurement confirms PO/terms (taylor) 3) Sales sends revised orderform to NTT and requests signature via DocuSign 4) Security sends SOC2 PDF on request (anna) 5) signature-bot to notify when signed.

raj_legal: Done — sending redline now. Please confirm we get their highlighted changes back.

_taylor_procure: I'll draft the orderform with PO field + billing block and set payment terms as net30 pending finance thumbs-up for net45.

signature-bot: DocuSign envelope created for "Redwood — NTT Data POC Orderform" (envelope id: 0a1b2c3d). Recipients: ntt_signer, emily_sales.

emily_sales: Sent to NTT. pinging @raj_legal and @taylor_procure for any last-minute issues.

raj_legal: One more: please ask NTT to initial the DPA redline for any clause they want changed — reduces back-and-forth.

emily_sales: Ack. I requested initialing and asked if provisional PO is acceptable until finance issues final one.

signature-bot: Envelope status: viewed by ntt_signer at 1747654360.

anna_sre: FYI — if they request tenant-specific HSM we need a Private deployment conversation + pricing. Flagging potential blocker if they insist.

emily_sales: Noted. I'll surface that if they push. For now, moving on signature path. :thumbsup:

signature-bot: Envelope completed at 1747654389. Signed orderform and DPA received — saving to deals/NTT/2026/attachments.

emily_sales: Fantastic — attaching signed copies to CRM and routing to finance for PO issuance. Thanks all for the quick turnaround. :party_parrot:
